# Guidelines & Privacy

Make sure to follow our guidelines!

### BotGhost ToS (Terms of Service)

By using BotGhost, you agree to adhere to our Terms of Service. It is expected that you follow these Terms while using the platform. You can view our Terms of Service [**here**](https://botghost.com/tos)**.**

### BotGhost Privacy Policy

At BotGhost, we take your privacy seriously. To help you understand what information we collect and why, we have outlined everything in our Privacy Policy. You can view it [**here**](https://botghost.com/privacy-policy)!

### BotGhost Security

Security is a key priority for BotGhost. We use trusted third-party providers to help ensure the protection of your information. For more details, visit our Security page [**here**](https://botghost.com/security)**.**

### BotGhost Market Guidelines

To maintain the integrity of the BotGhost Market, we have set guidelines for its use. You can learn more about the rules and expectations for the market by visiting our Market Guidelines page [**here**](https://botghost.com/market/guidelines)**.**

### Discord Guidelines

When using BotGhost, it is important to follow Discord's Community Guidelines. You can review Discord's Guidelines [**here**](https://discord.com/guidelines)**.**

### Discord Terms of Service

All BotGhost users are expected to comply with Discord's Terms of Service. You can read more about Discord's Terms of Service [**here**](https://discord.com/terms)**.**

{% hint style="info" %}
If you have any questions or concerns about these policies, please check out our [Help Center](https://help.botghost.com/support/home).
{% endhint %}
